scope_notes: BSB: 16 official empty references (Matt 17:21, 18:11, 23:14; Mark 7:16, 9:44, 9:46, 11:26, 15:28; Luke 17:36, 23:17; John 5:4; Acts 8:37, 15:34, 24:7, 28:29; Rom 16:24) are unlabelled, exactly as in the official TXT; the verse numbers are skipped

BSB: editorial section headings, cross-reference lines, footnotes, Psalms book headings and 44 \qa acrostic headings are not in the TXT and are not served (staging kept them in source-structure.json); superscriptions served as verse 1 per the TXT/USFM convention; Mark 16:9-20 and John 7:53-8:11 served without the print bracket/heading notes

KJV: 1611 Apocrypha, front matter (Epistle Dedicatory, Translators to the Reader), KJV book titles ('Otherwise Called…') and italics for supplied words are not served; the 66-book Protestant canon is the registry's stated scope

WEB: 794 {…} translator footnotes (5,458 tokens) removed by the importer; the current WEB's Psalm BOOK 1-5 headings and Song of Solomon speaker labels are absent from pg8294 as well; '[ ]' brackets around supplied words (1,296 pairs) come from the source
Text-critical verses, 1 John 5:7-8, Mark 16:9-20, John 7:53-8:11, Malachi 4, Joel 3, 3 John 14 and the Rom 14/16 doxology placement all match each edition's source (edition features, not defects)
